definitions.heroTurn: A hero/round group. E is assigned to the marker used, because the objective may advance before its action record. Actor serials are retained.
definitions.movement: Move segment or accepted basic jump/drop input, including combat-plus-movement turns. Straight-line displacement is a lower bound, not total path length or movement cost.
definitions.waiting: Stationary defense without HP/MP recovery outside the active mage hold and descent opportunity is an observable waiting proxy. Defense may still provide a useful guard; this is not a proof of uselessness.
definitions.noDamage: An accepted fire with no HP damage owned by that hero during its round. Terrain/shield contact may still be useful; this does not automatically mean a miss.
definitions.tail: First observed <=10/5/3/1 alive enemies after the final actual spawn. Last-known positions come from the preceding round observation, with recorded deaths/subduals removed.
definitions.timing: Engine simulation seconds, not human play duration. Bot planning and process wall time are separate result fields.
definitions.scope: Read-only analysis of native production inputs; map fixtures, previous failed probes and human/browser claims are excluded.
